# BTicino C300X Integration v2.1.2

## 2026-11-13

This release extends the native display: tiles get a chosen width and height,
media players can be controlled from the display, and the weather card can be
placed among the tiles. It adds an on-demand doorstation capture without a ring
and collects corrections to camera sessions, card actions, alarm services and
the native agent.

The device agent is rebuilt as **2.1.2** and has to be updated.

## Native Display

- Each entity tile gets a width (half or full) and a height (half or full). A
  full-height tile carries the entity's own buttons: up/stop/down for a cover,
  minus/plus for a thermostat target, brightness, fan speed or a number, and
  previous/next for a select. A fan's tile shows its speed next to on/off, as a
  light's shows its brightness. Automatic keeps the size each type had before,
  so existing dashboards do not change.
- Media players show what is playing. A full-height tile carries previous,
  play/pause and next; the submenu adds volume, mute, source and sound mode.
  Each button appears only when the player reports the feature its next step
  needs, and no command can start arbitrary media.
- **Weather - Page** and **Weather - Position** in the entity-display dialog
  place the weather card on any page among its tiles. Unplaced, it stays at the
  top of the status page.
- The display's QML and JavaScript files are written to the device without
  comments, blank lines and indentation, about 30 % smaller. The first update
  rewrites them once because their content hash changes.

## On-Demand Capture

- `capture_doorbell_call` gains `capture_mode: on_demand`. It records the
  doorstation without a ring, with or without audio, while media is idle and no
  other camera client is active. Until the capture ends, new camera clients are
  turned away. `ring` stays the default, so existing automations do not change;
  announcements remain available in ring mode only.

## Fixed

- Fan speed minus/plus moves to the fan's next speed. On a fan with few speeds
  minus could not lower it, because a fan rounds a percentage up to its next
  speed and the buttons stepped by one percent. Until the display files are
  updated, the display shows the speed with decimals, for example
  66.666666 %.
- On a number with a fractional step, such as 0.05 to 1 in steps of 0.05, the
  slider reaches the top of the range and plus at the top no longer lowers the
  value.
- Setting a light's brightness or a fan's speed to 0 on the display is
  confirmed once it is off, instead of ending as unconfirmed.
- A choice on the display offers its first options, at most 50 and at most
  2 kB of the display's answer, and every choice list is shortened further
  when the dashboard would still not fit. Long lists, such as a player's
  favourites, made every page show Home Assistant as unavailable. A dashboard
  too large for other reasons is logged as a warning.
- Emptying a page name in the entity-display dialog clears it, emptying a
  custom name shows the Home Assistant name again, and an emptied position
  returns to the automatic one, instead of bringing back the saved value.
- Emptying the weather entity, the alarm entity, the alarm page entity or the
  action list in the dashboard settings of an existing entry removes it
  instead of bringing back the saved value.
- The entity-display dialog cuts a page name to 60 characters and rounds a
  position to a whole number instead of returning to the dashboard settings
  without a message and losing the dialog's changes.
- Camera reconciliation can no longer close a doorbell session that is just
  starting. Closing a go2rtc session also closes its websocket on current Home
  Assistant versions.
- Overlapping event registrations keep the newest event selection and a single
  renewal timer.
- Card actions still in flight during a card reconfiguration finish on the
  camera they started on. While an answer is pending, a second Answer press is
  ignored and Hang Up still works.
- Hanging up, a closed connection or a replaced card cancels a microphone start
  still waiting for permission, so a late permission cannot restart the call. A
  Home Call can no longer take over a doorstation answer that is waiting for
  the microphone.
- Native agent deadlines use the monotonic clock, so setting or correcting the
  device clock no longer shortens or extends them.
- Voicemail and memo downloads no longer block the agent. At most four run at a
  time, a fifth is answered with `503 media_transfers_busy`, and a download
  that makes no progress for two seconds is closed.

## Changed

- Alarm service calls fail with a translated error when the alarm rejects the
  command or does not confirm the new state, instead of reporting success. Only
  an explicit code rejection is reported as a wrong PIN; a missing confirmation
  is reported as `alarm_state_unconfirmed`. Automations that call the alarm
  services against a slow alarm can now see that error.
- The agent reports a failed takeover of the device's media service as
  `media_takeover_failed`, and its log lines about it start with
  `device-media:`. Nothing in Home Assistant evaluates either.

## Upgrade

- The native agent moves to **2.1.2**. The agent-update Repair offers the
  update, the new display files come with it, and the integration re-applies an
  active Display patch itself, which restarts the device GUI once. Tile sizes,
  media player tiles and the placed weather card need these display files.
- Home Assistant 2026.7 remains the minimum. Existing integration entries and
  card configurations can be kept.

## Validation

- The release ran the full local and CI validation gates. The display layer is
  covered by source contract tests and a JavaScript harness only, because local
  tests do not execute the device's Qt runtime, so the display changes are not
  confirmed on hardware. The on-demand capture, the microphone cancellation and
  the native agent changes were not exercised on a physical C300X either.
